title: Stallion Drama!
summary: Please come see Disney’s “Dare To Dream”! This is a charming show with many songs you know and love! Featuring a darling teen- she strives to find her dream- even when it’s hard. The lead is played by Riley Jenkins- a freshman at Stansbury High- looking to make herself known and debut her talent! She’s just adorable! The production is May 18-19 at 7:30! Come see it before it’s gone! Tickets >$10!! Perfect show for families and kids! We’d love to see you there
